summary: Shaun Ryan (Shipibo name Ranko Meraya) is a single practitioner running paid Shamanic Ceremony evenings ($386/ticket) at dusk on the Blue Ridge Parkway, with drumming, breathwork and guided journeying. The three Eventbrite listings themselves are generic ('This is your invite to join us in Sacred Ceremony') with no membership language, but Shaun also runs a separate named $55/month membership program, 'The Sacred Circle,' explicitly built for returning participants with weekly calls and community support, and his site's testimonials suggest a base of repeat attendees.

evidence.note: Listing is a generic paid ceremony invite ('This is your invite to join us in Sacred Ceremony'), no mention of membership, dues, or named regulars; price $386.
Only 3 sparse events (median gap ~38.5 days) over Jan-Mar 2026, all led solely by organizer Shaun Meraya at Blue Ridge Parkway locations.

Shaun runs a separate, explicitly membership-based offering ('The Sacred Circle', $55/month) describing 'like-hearted members' and 'a community of like-hearted Beings supporting one another' with weekly live calls — real evidence of a returning-member community around his practice, though distinct from the specific ceremony product being evaluated.
About page and testimonials suggest an established base of returning clients but does not explicitly describe the outdoor Shamanic Ceremony events themselves as a membership or club.

Shaun also lists multi-day paid plant medicine retreats through BookRetreats.com, reinforcing that his primary offerings are commercial ceremony/retreat products rather than a free-standing community group.
